moreswitches.screen.title: More Switches
moreswitches.screen.hint: Press %s to open or close this screen
moreswitches.screen.language.tooltip: Auto follows the game language. Click to cycle Chinese / English.
moreswitches.tooltip.window_lock_on: Window size locked; position is unaffected. Turn the switch off to restore.
moreswitches.switch.window_lock.name: Lock Window Size
moreswitches.switch.window_lock.desc: No resize arrow on the edges; the size is fixed, but the window still moves.
moreswitches.switch.firework_cooldown.de: A rocket use is followed by a 3 second cooldown, so rapid clicks waste none.
moreswitches.switch.rain_sleep.name: Sleep Through Rain
moreswitches.switch.rain_sleep.desc: While it rains, a bed works in daylight and skips to the next day.
moreswitches.switch.drop_key_lock.name: Disable Q Drop
moreswitches.switch.drop_key_lock.desc: Q no longer drops an item, and Ctrl+Q no longer drops the stack.
F11 no longer toggles fullscreen; the button in video settings still works.
moreswitches.switch.effect_particles_off: Hides potion particles only; the effect itself is unchanged.
moreswitches.switch.light_preview.name: Preview Light Range
moreswitches.switch.light_preview.desc: Holding a light source, shows cyan light levels on nearby block tops.
moreswitches.switch.moving_light.name: Moving Light
moreswitches.switch.moving_light.desc: Holding a torch lights the area around you with a soft falloff.
moreswitches.switch.resource_pack_warnin: No warning or confirmation when enabling a version-mismatched pack.
moreswitches.switch.campfire_smoke_off.d: Campfires stop smoking; flames and cooking are unaffected.
moreswitches.switch.tutorial_off.name: No Tutorial
moreswitches.switch.tutorial_off.desc: No tutorial prompts, and no new-recipe reminders either.
moreswitches.switch.carpet_fake_player.d: Sets Carpet so /player works in survival. Reload the world to apply.
moreswitches.switch.totem_refill.name: Auto Refill Totem
moreswitches.switch.totem_refill.desc: Keeps a totem of undying in your offhand until you run out.
